name: MLS® HPI 'ESTRIE' — apartment benchmark price, September 2026
description: MLS® Home Price Index apartment benchmark price for CREA MLS® HPI market 'ESTRIE' (the Estrie region, larger than the Sherbrooke CMA), September 2026. Benchmark = modelled price of a typical apartment/condominium unit; used here as the price reference for the Sherbrooke profile.

attributes.geography_name: CREA MLS® HPI market 'ESTRIE' (the Estrie region, larger than the Sherbrooke CMA)
attributes.notes: MLS® HPI apartment benchmark, not seasonally adjusted. September 2025: $311,400; September 2026: $324,400. year_over_year_change_pct computed by agent-02 from these two CREA values.

sources.title: MLS® Home Price Index data download (Not Seasonally Adjusted, monthly), sheet ESTRIE
sources.methodology: MLS® HPI benchmark: price of a typical (benchmark) home whose attributes are held constant, estimated from completed MLS® sales; index 2005-01 = 100; methodology briefing at https://www.crea.ca/files/mls-hpi-data/english/Briefing-on-changes-to-HPI-methodology-ENG.pdf. Not seasonally adjusted series used.

verification.notes: Value read from CREA's MLS_HPI_Oct_2026.zip (data through September 2026), downloaded 2026-10-30; the national aggregate's -3.4% year-over-year matches CREA's 16 October 2026 release.

limitations: Benchmark price of a modelled typical home from completed MLS® sales; not an average or median of sales and not an asking price. Board market areas do not match Statistics Canada CMA boundaries. Monthly NSA values move with season and sales mix; CREA may revise back-series at its annual review. CREA's terms restrict republication: the map must link to or retrieve this figure on demand rather than display a stored copy (see METHODOLOGY.md).
